one_line: Sanskrit poet‑monk of the Kushan age, carrying Buddhist stories along the Silk Road.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, slim but healthy, slightly bookish build with calm posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, thoughtful eyes with slightly heavy lids, default expression a gentle, observant half‑smile.
appearance.hair: Short, straight black hair combed back from the forehead, no topknot, simple cloth headband in muted indigo tied around the crown like a travel band.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Buddhist monk’s robe in Gandhara-Kushan style: inner long‑sleeved tunic of undyed off‑white cotton reaching to mid‑calf; over it a saffron‑ochre cotton robe (saṃghāti) draped over the left shoulder and wrapped around the body, leaving the right shoulder covered as well for modesty; a second, thinner reddish‑brown woolen mantle used as a travel cloak around the upper body; simple loose trousers in light brown beneath the tunic, and soft leather sandals; minimal ornament—only a plain wooden mala around the left wrist, textiles mostly plain with subtle narrow border lines in darker ochre.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm‑leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cord, held in his left hand, with one loose palm leaf slightly visible at the edge.

ref_desc: Aśvaghoṣa is a mid‑40s, medium‑brown, bearded monk with short back‑combed black hair and indigo headband, wearing saffron‑ochre robes over off‑white tunic and brown trousers with reddish‑brown cloak and sandals, holding a red‑tied palm‑leaf manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character of Aśvaghoṣa: a dignified mid‑40s Sanskrit poet‑monk with an oval medium‑brown face, straight nose and neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, eyes thoughtful in a gentle half‑smile. His short black hair is combed back from the forehead and encircled by a simple muted indigo cloth headband tied around the crown. He wears Kushan‑era Buddhist monk garments: an off‑white long‑sleeved cotton tunic reaching mid‑calf, loose light‑brown trousers fully covering his legs, and soft brown leather sandals. Over this, drape a saffron‑ochre monk’s robe wrapped securely around his body, covering both shoulders modestly, with the fabric falling in realistic folds. Add a second reddish‑brown woolen mantle as a travel cloak layered around his upper body. Keep textiles plain with only subtle darker‑ochre border lines, and add a simple wooden mala bracelet on his left wrist. In his left hand he carries his signature prop: a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cord, one palm leaf edge peeking out. Use a palette dominated by saffron ochre, off‑white, reddish brown, indigo, and medium brown, and pose him standing calmly, ready to travel and teach along the Silk Road.
